name: Kagura Soushunfu
source:
Another installment in the Kagura series, featuring the ‘baka trio’ from the previous game Kagura Gensoutan as the protagonist and main heroines. After restoring peace to the school, Seiichirou, Yayoi, Azusa and Shizuru all leave to pursue their own futures, leaving Akira, Kanade and Makoto to continue their studies. However, there’s a feeling of uneasiness since there’s still one corner of the school building which hasn’t been fully sealed and it is teeming with youkai inside. How long will the barrier hold up and will they be able to overcome this danger even though they aren’t that experienced at all?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
神乐系列又一作，前作《神乐幻想谭》的「笨蛋三人组」担任主人公和主要女主角。学校恢复和平后，诚一郎、弥生、梓和静流都离开追逐各自未来，只剩晶、奏和真继续学习。然而，校舍仍有一角尚未完全封印，里面充满妖怪，令人不安。结界还能支撑多久？毫无经验的他们能克服这场危机吗？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
